key:<Space>M.note: Toggles memory search. MemorySearch {query, max_results: 10, project_id: null} on every edit, like the TUI; rows show path [score] and the snippet. Up/Down or Ctrl-N/Ctrl-P move, Esc closes; j/k/q type into the query (the desktop's single-line field rule, as in the TUI's standard editing; Vim mode in the TUI keeps them as commands)

overlay-ref:ai-command.note: Ctrl-Alt-A in the message box, the launch and continue prompts and the input modal (plain Ctrl-A stays select-all, as in the TUI's standard editing; Cmd on macOS), or the palette: GenerateText {system, prompt} with the TUI's AI_COMMAND_SYSTEM_PROMPT and INSTRUCTION/SOURCE TEXT layout; typing, Backspace, Enter runs, Esc cancels; the result is a preview (a accepts, d / Esc discard). Substitute for the model: rsid's configured prompt-processor model runs, because the TUI's own prompt_processor choice is TUI state that no RPC serves

overlay-ref:ai-chat.note: Ctrl-Shift-A in the message box, the launch and continue prompts and the input modal, or the palette: GenerateText with the TUI's AI_CHAT_SYSTEM_PROMPT and SOURCE TEXT/CONVERSATION layout, multi-turn, errors kept as 'Error: ...' turns; Enter sends, Up/Down scroll, Esc clears then closes, q closes an empty input. Substitute for the model: rsid's configured prompt-processor model (the TUI's own choice is TUI state)

cmd:card.note: :card, :card user, :card add <fact>, :card user add <fact> parsed exactly like commands.rs; add reads the card and writes it back with the fact appended (40 max)

overlay:card-editor-overlay-card-card-us.note: GetEntityCard/SetEntityCard for the current project (open session's, else the list's project filter) or the user card (self). j/k, g/G, a, e/i/Enter, dd, J/K reorder, Ctrl-S save, Esc/q save and close; edit: Enter commits (empty deletes), Esc cancels (a new empty fact is removed); every change saves the whole card like the TUI; 40-fact cap; Space N / Space ; leave the overlay

cmd:ask.note: QueryMemory {query, project_id, conversation_history} scoped to the current project (else global): Enter sends, s (empty input) toggles the sources, Up/Down scroll, Esc clears then closes, q closes an empty input; :ask <question> fills the input as in the TUI
